pages.title: Social life without a backlog
pages.subtitle: Local interactions have procedural outcomes. Generated dialogue is an optional audible layer.

rows: Local people spend time together without model requests. Some encounters affect relationships; recent witnessed events can spread as reports.
Reports retain their origin and date, lose confidence when forwarded, and do not become personal eyewitness memories. Duplicates do not farm trust penalties.
Model dialogue starts only within earshot (10 m), subject to substantial barriers. Small objects do not mute voices. Brief occlusion has a two-second grace for work already in progress.
Busy background requests are rejected; stale narration is discarded. Player dialogue interrupts incidental reactions, including those from the same NPC.

images.caption: Actual Qwen exchange between Nusa and Natot, followed by the player interrupting. The existing thoughts overlay shows the active intention and queue. Actor positions were controlled for functional testing.

blocks.heading: Verified
blocks.text: 87 Core checks passed, plus all 26 final packaged social checks and 14 packaged safety checks. Tests include AI-disabled gossip outside earshot, obstruction, no backlog under thirty incidental requests, live streaming, turn-taking, player interruption and saved-state validation.

blocks.heading: Scope
blocks.text: Only loaded local people take part; no world-wide simulation of individual conversations. Model speed and prose quality are unchanged. These are functional checks, not evidence of an FPS gain.
